name: GitHub
description: Run an agent when something happens in a repository - an issue, a pull request, a comment that mentions it, a failed workflow, a release or a push.

presets.label: New issue opened
presets.description: Fires when someone opens an issue in the repository you pick.

presets.label: Issue closed
presets.description: Fires when an issue is closed.

presets.label: Issue reopened
presets.description: Fires when a closed issue is reopened.

presets.label: Pull request ready for review
presets.description: Fires when a pull request is opened (not as a draft), marked ready for review, or a review is requested.

presets.label: Comment mentioning the agent
presets.description: Fires when a comment on an issue or pull request contains the phrase you set, such as @agent.

presets.label: Workflow run failed
presets.description: Fires when a GitHub Actions workflow run finishes with a failure.

presets.label: Release published
presets.description: Fires when a release is published.

presets.label: Push to a branch
presets.description: Fires when commits are pushed to the branches you set - main by default.

name: Gmail
description: Run an agent when a message arrives in your mailbox - all of it, or a slice you filter.

presets.label: Any new message
presets.description: Fires on every message that arrives. Narrow it with a sender, a subject or a label below.

presets.label: Inbox only
presets.description: Fires on a message Gmail files in the inbox, so anything your own filters moved aside is skipped.

presets.label: Marked important
presets.description: Fires only on what Gmail marks important - the narrowest of the three, and the cheapest to run often.

name: Outlook
description: Run an agent when a message arrives in a Microsoft 365 mailbox - your inbox, a folder your rules file into, or a shared mailbox.

presets.label: Any new message
presets.description: Fires on every message that lands in the inbox. Narrow it with a sender or a subject below.

presets.label: With attachments
presets.description: Fires only on a message that carries a file - an invoice, a contract, a report to read.

presets.label: High importance
presets.description: Fires only on what the sender marked high importance - the narrowest of the three.

name: Google Drive
description: Run an agent when a file is added to or changed in Google Drive - anywhere, or in one folder.

presets.label: New files
presets.description: Fires when a file is added - an upload, a scan, a document somebody shared. Narrow it to a folder or a name below.

presets.label: New or changed files
presets.description: Fires on a new file and on an edit to one; a file kept being edited fires at most once in half an hour.

name: OneDrive & SharePoint
description: Run an agent when a file is added to or changed in your OneDrive or a SharePoint site's library.

presets.label: New files
presets.description: Fires when a file is added - an upload, a scan, a document somebody shared. Narrow it to a folder or a name below.

presets.label: New or changed files
presets.description: Fires on a new file and on an edit to one; a file kept being edited fires at most once in half an hour.

name: Google Calendar
description: Run an agent a set time before a meeting - to prepare a brief on who is coming and what was said last time.

presets.label: Before each meeting
presets.description: Fires 15 minutes before a meeting with somebody else on it - time for an agent to prepare a brief.

presets.label: Before meetings with outsiders
presets.description: Fires 15 minutes before a meeting with somebody from outside your organization - a client, a candidate, a partner.

presets.label: An hour before
presets.description: Fires an hour ahead, for a brief that needs research rather than a glance.

name: Outlook Calendar
